overview_description.description: hiloop provides infrastructure for automated research and machine learning experimentation. Its platform provisions compute environments that agents can snapshot, fork, restore, and use to run experiments. The system records experiment activity as telemetry and links compute state with run lineage. Users can query captured events with SQL, add structured annotations, and derive views such as trajectories or training exports. Hiloop supports customer-provided research harnesses and can run in hosted environments or within a customer's cloud or on-premises infrastructure.
